description: For any unary partial function \(g\), composing the total constant-zero function after \(g\) is defined exactly where \(g\) is defined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.constant_strict_domain (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
  ((f x).bind fun x => Part.some 0).Dom ↔ (f x).Dom
